exposure: Cesarean section with bilateral salpingectomy (CS + BS)
cohort: Women >35 weeks' gestation scheduled for CS alone or CS + BS
finding: Bilateral salpingectomy at the time of cesarean section did not have a negative impact on ovarian reserve 6 months after surgery.
mod_finding: Bilateral salpingectomy at the time of cesarean section did not have a negative impact on ovarian reserve 6 months after surgery.
